actions.action: Opened the action menu for completed book The Great Gatsby.
Inspected the status and Current Page control.

observations: The completed card opened an edit dialog showing Status To Read and Current Page 0.
Current Page was enabled and modifiable instead of being forced to the completed total/100%.
notes: Completed-book editing loses completed state and exposes an editable progress field.
